name: fg-grants-core
description: Local infrastructure to aid development of grants services.

scripts.docker:up:cw: docker compose -f compose.yml  -f compose/compose.gas.yml -f compose/compose.cw-backend.yml -f compose/compose.cw-frontend.yml -f compose/compose.override.yml up --build --watch
scripts.docker:up:grants-ui: docker compose -f compose.yml -f compose/compose.grants-ui.yml -f compose/compose.land-grants.yml -f compose/compose.gas.yml -f compose/compose.cw-backend.yml -f compose/compose.cw-frontend.yml  -f compose/compose.override.yml --profile grants-ui up --build
scripts.docker:up:agreements: docker compose -f compose.yml -f compose/compose.grants-ui.yml -f compose/compose.land-grants.yml -f compose/compose.gas.yml -f compose/compose.cw-backend.yml -f compose/compose.cw-frontend.yml  -f compose/compose.agreements-api.yml -f compose/compose.agreements-ui.yml -f compose/compose.override.yml --profile grants-ui --profile agreements up --build
